"""design_94F5 모델링 준비: tp 단위 데이터셋, 라벨, 분할 키 생성 (학습/성능 계산 없음)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = WS / "data"
OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_94F5.json").read_text())

pat = pd.read_csv(DATA / "patients.csv.gz")
adm = pd.read_csv(DATA / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(DATA / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

# --- tp 생성: admit + offset. 입원 중(tp < discharge)인 tp만 둔다 (설계 질문 '입원 중 매일') ---
tps = adm.merge(pd.DataFrame({"offset_h": design["tp"]["offsets_h"]}), how="cross")
tps["tp"] = tps["admit_time"] + tps["offset_h"] * H
n_all = len(tps)
tps["in_hospital_at_tp"] = tps["tp"] < tps["discharge_time"]
tps["window_complete"] = tps["tp"] + 48 * H <= tps["discharge_time"]
tps = tps.merge(pat, on="patient_id", how="left")

cr = labs[labs.test == "creatinine"].copy()


def kdigo_flags(df, tcol):
    """각 크레아티닌 측정에 대해 같은 입원 내 이전 값 기준 KDIGO 충족 여부 (tcol 시간축)."""
    df = df.sort_values(["admission_id", tcol]).copy()
    flags = np.zeros(len(df), bool)
    for _, g in df.groupby("admission_id", sort=False):
        t = g[tcol].values
        v = g["value"].values
        idx = g.index
        for i in range(len(g)):
            prev48 = v[(t < t[i]) & (t >= t[i] - np.timedelta64(48, "h"))]
            prev7d = v[(t < t[i]) & (t >= t[i] - np.timedelta64(168, "h"))]
            ok = (len(prev48) and v[i] - prev48.min() >= 0.3) or (len(prev7d) and v[i] >= 1.5 * prev7d.min())
            flags[df.index.get_loc(idx[i])] = bool(ok)
    df["kdigo"] = flags
    return df


cr_rep = kdigo_flags(cr, "report_time")   # tp 시점에 알 수 있는 정보 기준 (제외 기준)
cr_col = kdigo_flags(cr, "collect_time")  # 결과 정의 (collect_time 기준)

rows = tps[["admission_id", "tp"]]


def window_agg(src, tcol, start, end, func, col="value"):
    m = rows.reset_index().merge(src, on="admission_id")
    m = m[(m[tcol] >= start(m)) & (m[tcol] < end(m))] if func != "le" else m
    return m, m.groupby("index")


def lab_feature(test, start_h, agg):
    s = labs[labs.test == test]
    m = rows.reset_index().merge(s, on="admission_id").merge(tps[["admit_time"]], left_on="index", right_index=True)
    lo = m["admit_time"] if start_h is None else m["tp"] - start_h * H
    m = m[(m.report_time >= lo) & (m.report_time <= m.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
    g = m.groupby("index")["value"]
    r = {"min": g.min, "max": g.max, "last": g.last, "count": g.size}[agg]()
    return r.reindex(tps.index).fillna(0 if agg == "count" else np.nan)


# 제외: admit~tp 사이 보고된 크레아티닌으로 이미 AKI 확인
m = rows.reset_index().merge(cr_rep, on="admission_id").merge(tps[["admit_time"]], left_on="index", right_index=True)
m = m[(m.report_time >= m.admit_time) & (m.report_time <= m.tp)]
tps["aki_known_by_tp"] = m.groupby("index")["kdigo"].any().reindex(tps.index).fillna(False).astype(bool)

# 결과: [tp, tp+48h) 채취 크레아티닌 중 KDIGO 충족 (기준값은 같은 입원 내 tp-168h 이후 이전 측정)
m = rows.reset_index().merge(cr_col, on="admission_id")
m = m[(m.collect_time >= m.tp) & (m.collect_time < m.tp + 48 * H)]
tps["aki_48h"] = m.groupby("index")["kdigo"].any().reindex(tps.index).fillna(False).astype(int)
tps["n_cr_in_outcome_window"] = m.groupby("index").size().reindex(tps.index).fillna(0).astype(int)

# 특징
tps["cr_min_adm"] = lab_feature("creatinine", None, "min")
tps["k_last"] = lab_feature("potassium", None, "last")
tps["bun_last"] = lab_feature("bun", None, "last")
tps["cr_max_48h"] = lab_feature("creatinine", 48, "max")
tps["cr_last"] = lab_feature("creatinine", None, "last")
tps["hgb_min"] = lab_feature("hemoglobin", None, "min")
tps["n_cr"] = lab_feature("creatinine", None, "count")
hist = tps[["patient_id", "tp"]].reset_index().merge(adm[["patient_id", "admit_time"]], on="patient_id")
tps["n_admissions_to_tp"] = hist[hist.admit_time <= hist.tp].groupby("index").size().reindex(tps.index)
# unit, sex, age 는 그대로 사용

# 코호트
cohort = tps[(tps.age >= 18) & tps.in_hospital_at_tp & ~tps.aki_known_by_tp].copy()

# 분할: 설계 키 family_id 는 결측이 많아 patient_id 로 보충한 그룹키를 별도 열로 둔다
cohort["split_group_design"] = cohort["family_id"]
cohort["split_group"] = cohort["family_id"].fillna(cohort["patient_id"])
sp = design["split"]
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=sp["test_fraction"], random_state=sp["seed"])
tr, te = next(gss.split(cohort, groups=cohort["split_group"]))
cohort["split"] = "train"
cohort.iloc[te, cohort.columns.get_loc("split")] = "test"

feat = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "offset_h", "tp",
        "window_complete", "n_cr_in_outcome_window"] + feat + ["aki_48h"]
cohort[cols].to_csv(OUT / "cohort_tp.csv.gz", index=False)

# 요약
s = {
    "tp_all": n_all,
    "tp_in_hospital": int(tps.in_hospital_at_tp.sum()),
    "tp_excluded_aki_known": int((tps.in_hospital_at_tp & tps.aki_known_by_tp).sum()),
    "cohort_rows": len(cohort),
    "cohort_admissions": cohort.admission_id.nunique(),
    "cohort_patients": cohort.patient_id.nunique(),
    "cohort_window_incomplete": int((~cohort.window_complete).sum()),
    "cohort_window_incomplete_no_cr": int(((~cohort.window_complete) & (cohort.n_cr_in_outcome_window == 0)).sum()),
    "tp_after_discharge_if_not_filtered": int((~tps.in_hospital_at_tp).sum()),
    "family_id_missing_rows": int(cohort.family_id.isna().sum()),
    "family_id_missing_patients": int(cohort.loc[cohort.family_id.isna(), "patient_id"].nunique()),
    "split_rows": cohort.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "split_patients": cohort.groupby("split").patient_id.nunique().to_dict(),
    "patient_overlap_train_test": int(len(set(cohort[cohort.split == "train"].patient_id) & set(cohort[cohort.split == "test"].patient_id))),
    "missing_rate": cohort[feat].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "by_unit": cohort.groupby("unit").agg(rows=("aki_48h", "size"), n_cr_mean=("n_cr", "mean"),
                                          cr_in_window_mean=("n_cr_in_outcome_window", "mean")).round(3).to_dict(),
    "by_offset_rows": cohort.offset_h.value_counts().sort_index().to_dict(),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
